title: QA Signal
description: Small producer facts. Legacy metadata-free signals remain readable but cannot verify quality. Gate policy additionally requires revision, runId, and completedAt, with exact expected identity and bounded age.

area.description: One unique project-defined dimension per invocation, such as correctness, reliability, security, or maintainability. Shards must aggregate in their producer or use distinct required areas.

reason.description: Reason a check was skipped, unavailable, or qualified; include residual risk and next owner in the QA packet.

revision.description: Immutable revision identifier actually checked, compared exactly with caller policy; do not use a moving branch name.

runId.description: Caller-owned execution identity, including attempt identity when runs can be retried.

completedAt.description: UTC completion timestamp with seconds and optional three-digit milliseconds; producer must derive from the actual execution.
